Comment 0 (2010-08-09): What steps will reproduce the problem? Compile this: var x=0,y=1;x||y=8 What is the expected output? What do you see instead? I expect an error, because this is parsed as (x||y)=8, which is an invalid left-hand side of an assignment. Instead, I get var x=0,y=1;x||y=8; which, like the input, is invalid code.
